lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters; higher density of smaller blobs immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to larger, more sparsely distributed blobs towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a linear sharp gradient of high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density random clustering of small high-luminance blobs on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
